summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (TSMC) filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in treasurer at its major subsidiary TSMC Arizona Corporation effective July 1, 2026. Gina Proctor no longer serves as Treasurer; a replacement will be announced after board appointment. This is an internal management adjustment at a subsidiary, not a routine meeting notice. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor are named. The filing is procedural with no special-situation catalyst. Watch for the subsequent appointment announcement to assess continuity.
